testimonials.description: Authentic reviews from people who experienced an exceptional stay at Riva Zegrze

item1.name: Bartek
item1.text: A modern, brand-new apartment with all the amenities. Access to the pool and gym was a huge plus. We had no problem bringing our dog, and there's a great area for walks right next to the building. Communication with the staff was top-notch — quick and hassle-free. We'll definitely be back 😊

item3.name: Magdalena
item3.text: The apartment was very clean, cozy, and excellently equipped. The property is set in a beautiful area. Easy to reach. Very comfortable bed. Great communication with the owner.

item4.name: Magdalena
item4.text: A beautiful, modern apartment — very cozy and clean. The balcony view was lovely, and the pool made a huge, positive impression. A quiet, picturesque area. Communication with the owner was excellent.

item5.name: Joanna
item5.text: Location. Beautifully landscaped grounds around the buildings. Fully equipped kitchen. Large balcony. Beautiful view from the window. Elevator making it easy to move around with luggage. Comfortable, spacious shower.

item6.name: Mariusz
item6.text: If I plan a visit to the area, I will definitely come back. Excellent communication with the property host.

item7.name: Agnieszka
item7.text: Peace, quiet, beautiful view. Very good communication with the owner. Very clean, wonderful location. Excellent apartment furnishings.

item8.name: Jagoda
item8.text: A great place for a weekend — highly recommend. I might come back. Cleanliness, easy access, pool, comfort in the apartment.

item9.name: Maria
item9.text: The apartment is situated in a beautiful, picturesque location. The option to use pedal boats and kayaks is an added bonus. Getting there from Warsaw — by car or train — is hassle-free. The people we contacted were always kind and helpful. We'll definitely return to this place :)

item10.name: Sylwester
item10.text: Modern apartments in an excellent location. Private access to the piers, with the option to rent kayaks and a pedal boat. A very well-equipped gym and an amazing pool. Beautifully maintained garden with trimmed lawns. The apartment is well-equipped — washer-dryer, dishwasher, iron with ironing board, dishes, cutlery — everything nicely arranged.

faq.sectionDescription: Answers to the most important questions about your stay at Riva Zegrze

checkin.question: What time is check-in?
checkin.answer: Check-in is possible between 3:00 PM and 10:00 PM. The property offers self check-in – access codes are sent on the day of arrival.

earlyLate.question: Is early check-in or late check-out possible?
earlyLate.answer: The possibility of early check-in or late check-out depends on availability and is arranged individually.

extraBeds.question: Are extra beds available in the apartments?
extraBeds.answer: No, we do not offer extra beds. Each apartment is designed for a maximum of 4 people.

children.question: Can children stay in the apartments?
children.answer: Yes, the property is family-friendly. Children of all ages are welcome.

pets.question: Can I bring a dog?
pets.answer: Yes, pets are accepted and we do not charge extra fees for them.

parking.question: Is parking available on-site?
parking.answer: Yes, free public parking spaces are available in front of the building.

garage.question: Can I reserve a garage parking space?
garage.answer: Yes, a garage space is available upon prior reservation for PLN 75 / day.

quietHours.question: Are there quiet hours at the property?
quietHours.answer: Yes, quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM.

parties.question: Can I organize parties at the property?
parties.answer: No, organizing parties, including bachelor and bachelorette parties, is strictly prohibited on the premises.
